name: Lisbon, Portugal
description: A hilly coastal capital known for its pastel buildings, tram 28 route, fado music, and easy day trips to Sintra. Great for travelers who want walkable old-town charm with strong food and coffee culture, mild winters, and a lower cost of living than most of Western Europe.

name: Kyoto, Japan
description: Japan's former capital, packed with temples, traditional wooden machiya houses, and the Arashiyama bamboo grove. Best for travelers interested in history, quiet gardens, and a slower pace than Tokyo. Cherry blossom season (late March-April) and autumn foliage (November) are the most popular times to visit.

name: Cartagena, Colombia
description: A colorful Caribbean port city with a walled colonial old town, salsa music, and nearby beaches on the Rosario Islands. Good fit for travelers wanting warm weather year-round, vibrant nightlife, and a mix of history and beach time in one trip.

name: Queenstown, New Zealand
description: An adventure-sports hub on Lake Wakatipu, surrounded by mountains. Bungee jumping, skydiving, hiking, and skiing in winter. Best for travelers prioritizing outdoor activities and dramatic scenery over city life; it's a small town, not a metropolis.

name: Marrakech, Morocco
description: A city built around a maze-like medina, souks, and riads with interior courtyards. Known for intense sensory experiences -- markets, spices, mint tea -- and easy access to the Atlas Mountains and Sahara desert tours. Good for travelers who enjoy bargaining, dense old-city exploration, and don't mind heat in summer.
